channel.title: FarawayDrip30 Game News
channel.description: For uh... news on my games...

item.title: BAY OF PIGS: THE VIDEOGAME
item.description: After all our coursework, our class had a tuesday to friday game jam, where we made THIS! The theme was Roles Reversed and we reversed the tower defence genre. I got to do a lot of the game design for this one which was fun! I do feel a bit bad because there was another cool tower another team member made and I cut it for balance which blows but I want to make a new versino of the game sometime where I can polish it and fix the bugs and issues and add the tower in hopefully.

item.title: Saci Game
item.description: This is a university project for my responsable game design class, where we had to design a game. This is just a short prototype for my idea, which you can read about more on the itch page.

item.title: Evading the Police via a Pee Jetstream Simulator
item.description: It was busy what with having to finish all my uni projects around this time, but FARAWAYDRIP30 NEVER MISSES A YEAR! Bit of a simpler WSPS game this year but I still think it's pretty neat, go play it HERE!! (actual release data was 1st April)

item.title: Introducing Funky Town Selects, Vol. 1!
item.description: The homeboy Cristobal started a little art jam for games, drawings, etc for all of us in the Funky Town group in order to put all our submissions into a collection we called at the time the Funkyllection. It's got a load of cool shit from other members, but I managed to contribute the games Ioio's House and My Awesome Drivable Bongos, as well as the first """""officially released" Clifford and Heimlich comic, Underground. I locked in for a week for My Awesome Cool Driveable Bongos, I think it's pretty fun. It released at 1AM today, check it out here!

item.title: Fish Game is Fish Out!
item.description:
good friend of the show flines wanted to make a jam game so he could rearrange his itch.io page and make it look all nice so we decided to do that.

We looked at some jams to do on itch but there weren't any appealing to us on Wednesday (which is when i was next free enough to do it) so we decided to just do a personal one. I thought it was 2 days but apparently it was three. Overall it was a really chilly jammy, there was no stress at any point except for maybe just because we got lazy at the end but that's not stress. that's laziness. I even just dipped for an afternoon and watched Paul McCartney: Man on the Run at the cinema. Which was a good film. We are freaking epic. Shoutout to the homeboy. No relation to WallGame.

item.title: WallGame is OutGame!
item.description:
This has been in the backburner for a while. WallGame is OUT! I started and basically finished its original Java version in GCSE Computer Science like 2/3 years ago now (wow), but only recently decided to finish it by adding sounds, a soundtrack, some QOL, and ported it in its entirety to Javascript and added Newgrounds shit. Unfortunately the sound system in Java is really jank so I'm not gonna release that just yet and try to fix it, but I hope you like the java version!
(It even has a trailer!)

item.title: Less Trains Please Available on Armor Games
item.description: LTP can now be played on Armor Games! It's really cool to see a game I made be present with the same intro screen that old flash games I used to play

item.title: Less Trains Please RELEASED!!!
item.description: [02/11/2025]> Finally released the game me and flines have been making for like the last 4 months, Less Trains, Please...? Really happy with how the game turned out, also made a day 1 update. I will probably make a blog on a retrospective of the game at some point!
